arStrings.szText: "Marcellus is dead. Temis is safe from Morlu."
I knew I could count on you to handle this properly. The Amazons are in your debt.
We’ve rounded up the remnants of Marcellus' inner circle, and returned the money where we could. We’ll use what’s left to give Cleon a decent burial.
We'd like to present you with this weapon, as a sign of our esteem. We hope you see fit to remain in Skovos, among friends.
